# Province of British Columbia

> The official BC government portal providing comprehensive public services, life events management, and citizen information across all provincial sectors.

www2.gov.bc.ca is the primary digital gateway for British Columbians to access government services, information, and resources. The site serves residents, businesses, and public sector employees through organized service categories spanning healthcare, education, employment, housing, justice, and natural resources.

## Key Topics

- Province of British Columbia
- BC Public Service

## Core Government Portal

- [Home - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/home): Official homepage for BC government with service directory and life events
- [Find B.C. government services - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/home/services-a-z): A-Z directory of BC government services via Service BC
- [British Columbians and our governments - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/governments): BC government structure, organization and public services overview

## Citizen Services & Life Events

- [Birth, adoption, death, marriage and divorce - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/life-events): Vital records and life events services via Vital Statistics Agency
- [Taxes and tax credits - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/taxes): Provincial taxes, tax credits and eTaxBC services for BC residents
- [Housing and tenancy - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/housing-tenancy): Housing, tenancy and residential programs including BC Housing
- [Family and social supports - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/family-social-supports): Family services, childcare, seniors and disability assistance programs

## Health, Education & Safety

- [Health - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/health): Healthcare services including PharmaCare and health access programs
- [Education and training - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/education-training): Education and training theme page for K-12 and post-secondary in BC
- [Public safety and emergency services - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/safety): Public safety, emergency services and disaster preparedness programs
- [Law, crime and justice - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/justice): Legal system, justice services and court information for BC

## Employment, Business & Economic Development

- [Employment, business and economic development - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/employment-business): Employment, business and economic development theme page for BC
- [Farming, natural resources and industry - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/industry): Natural resources, agriculture, forestry, mining and industry sectors
- [Tourism and immigration - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/tourism-immigration): Tourism, immigration and WelcomeBC services for newcomers
- [Careers & MyHR - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/careers-myhr): BC Public Service careers and HR services for employees

## Transportation & Environment

- [Driving and transportation - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/transportation): Transportation services including DriveBC, licensing and road safety
- [Environmental protection and sustainability - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/environment): Environmental protection, sustainability and natural resource management

## Community & Culture

- [Sports, recreation, arts and culture - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/sports-culture): Sports, recreation, arts and culture programs and community grants

## Reference & Data

- [Data and information management - Province of British Columbia](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/data): BC government data management, policy and geographic data resources
